title: Ramji Londonwale
description: This is the story about Ramji, who is a skilled cook and flies to London to try his luck in work. It is the story about his journey and life in London.

title: Disco Dancer
description: Anil's mother is falsely accused of theft and jailed. Anil swears to set this right one day. Years later, he becomes a big star and restores his mother's honour. Now his fame earns him more enemies.

title: Na Tum Jaano Na Hum
description: A romantically inclined couple decide to get to know each other through letters without disclosing their identities.

title: Hum Aapke Dil Mein Rehte Hain
description: Not knowing what consequences she would face, a woman signs a 1-year marriage contract with a business tycoon to end her family's poverty.

title: Kati Patang
description: A runaway bride (Asha Parekh) promises her dying widowed friend that she will assume her identity and raise her child as the rightful heir to his family name.

title: Do Anjane
description: Six years after train attack, amnesiac seeks revenge on ex and best friend, and fights for son.

title: Mohabat Ke Dushman
description: The beauty of Shamajaan is appreciated by many and out of which Shahbaaz Khan, a notorious man, desires to make her one of his wives. When she refuses, he kills her father.

title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 1
description: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life.

title: Pyare Mohan
description: Pyare and Mohan, two friends with visual and hearing disabilities respectively, fall in love with Preeti and Priya. When the women are charged with murder, the two try to save them.

title: Pehchaan The Face Of Truth
description: A woman fights for justice for her dead friend who is murdered by her in-laws and the case is closed as a suicide case. But soon, she finds herself in the same situation and has to fight her in-laws.

title: Professor Ki Padosan
description: Vidyadhar consumes a potion to become invisible in order to escape his wife Shobha's ire when she learns of his affair with Menka.

title: Kabhi Na Kabhi
description: Jaggu gets arrested after a witness informs the police about his crimes. Meanwhile, Raja is hired in his place. Once out, Jaggu kills the witness, who happens to be Raja's father.

title: Sadak
description: A young man who falls in love with a sex worker must overcome the social stigma as well as face the brothel owner and some criminal elements.

title: Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega
description: Raj, Pooja and Jhanvi are in a complicated love triangle. Pooja and Jhanvi love Raj. Raj loves Jhanvi but is misunderstood as Pooja's husband by their family. How will the confusion clear off.

title: Ajanabee
description: Middle-classed Rohit (Rajesh Khanna) falls in love with rich Reshmi (Zeenat Aman) and marries her. But fate has other plans and he gets arrested for the murder which he never committed.
